name: sg-connector-gate
description: Enforces Snow Gloves connector-gate on catalog-managed MCP servers: hold and refuse cards never run, a server must be enabled for the tenant, and high-risk or approval cards need an approved ticket

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: Tenant slug. Empty: SNOWGLOVES_TENANT, else the gate only observes

dataRoot.title: Data root
dataRoot.description: Path of the private snow-gloves-ops checkout. Empty: SNOWGLOVES_DATA, else the platform's public fixtures

platformRoot.title: Platform root
platformRoot.description: Path of the snow-gloves-os checkout. Empty: two folders above this mod

gateMode.title: Gate mode
gateMode.description: enforce refuses calls the catalog does not allow; observe only logs what it would refuse

ttlHours.title: Approval lifetime (hours)
ttlHours.description: How long an approved ticket lets the same tool through
